sourceNote: スペースジャグラー: MEASURED by pokemon-infomation.com across 1,200 aggregated boxes (36,000 packs). Their per-BOX figures: SR(ポケモン) ~45.0%, SR(サポート) ~25.0%, SA(特別なアート) ~12.0%, HR(ポケモン) ~9.0%, HR(サポート) ~9.0%, UR ~10.0%; one SR-or-better guaranteed per box (~10% of boxes carry two). This era's catalog has no AR or SAR tier, so the bands map as the sibling パラダイムトリガー file already does: ultra_rare = SR + SA = 45+25+12=82%/box; hyper_rare = HR + UR = 9+9+10=28%/box; double_rare = the RR/RRR band at ~4.5/box. Rates come from ポケゲトちゃんねる (pokemon-infomation.com), which aggregates real box-opening tallies from card shops and individuals — the closest thing Japanese sets have to a primary study, since neither The Pokemon Company nor any English source publishes Japanese odds. Confidence is MEDIUM: the sample is large and the methodology is consistent across sets, but the tallies are not independently auditable. Per-pack probabilities are the site's per-BOX figures divided by this box's 30 packs. NOTE ON GUARANTEES: per-box guarantees (3 AR/box, 1 ACE SPEC/box, ~1 SR-or-better/box) are FOLDED INTO the slot rates rather than modelled as engine floors — a floor attaches to a PRODUCT, so a single-pack product would inherit the whole box's guarantee and read absurdly positive. A box's EV already reflects every guarantee.
